summary: One church, bilingual (English/Polish). The schedule box and intentions agree in both bulletins read (Nov 8 and Nov 15, 2026): Sat 5 PM vigil; Sun 8 & 11 (Polish), 9:30 and 7 PM; Mon-Sat 7 AM; Wed 7 PM Polish Mass with 6-7 PM Adoration and confession; Sat 4-5 PM Adoration and confession; first Friday 6-9 PM Adoration, confession 6-8:45 and a 9 PM Mass. Open: whether 'Confessions after Mass' means Mon-Sat 7:30 AM.
